seo.title: Nimbo — A Mood Journal with a Little Cloud
seo.description: A mood journal for iPhone and Apple Watch with a friend in it. Nimbo, a small cloud, asks once a day how the weather is inside: Sunny, Mild, Clear, Drizzly or Stormy. A year of sky, a forecast you can read, widgets and Apple Health. No account, no tracking.

hero.label: MOOD JOURNAL
hero.title: The weather inside.
text: Meet Nimbo, a little cloud who asks how the sky looks inside. One tap a day, a year of weather, and a forecast you can read.
